title: My first manager on leadership shown early
summary: My first manager at IBM wrote that I got involved in project initiatives and mentoring interns very early, which showed leadership.
what_i_did: Took on project initiatives, intern mentoring and technical vitality work from the start.

quotes.text: He had, in a very early stage of his career started getting involved in the project initiatives, mentoring interns and other technical vitality activities, which showed his leadership capabilities.
